provenance_note: Each pin below is the exact head of the final evaluated pull request for that repository. No pin is on its repository's origin/main; every pull request is PENDING_REQUIRED_HUMAN_REVIEW under branch protection. This manifest binds the immutable CONTENT BASE only: the cybrik-suite pin is the authoring parent of the commit that carries this manifest, because a manifest cannot contain its own commit SHA. The final post-merge release is bound OUTSIDE this file by the external release-tag envelope v1.0.0-rc1 (see release_tag_envelope), which is created after the four pull requests merge and which binds the merged main-line SHAs. The two bindings are complementary and neither is a substitute for the other.

release_tag_envelope.why_two_bindings: A manifest committed into cybrik-suite cannot name its own SHA, and pre-merge PR heads are rewritten by rebase. The content-base pins therefore record what was evaluated; the external release tag records what was released. Reading a content-base pin as a released SHA is a category error (ABMB-04).
